content: Hello, thanks for contacting support. How can I assist you today?
Hi, I’m locked out of my account and need to reset my password.
I can help with that. Please navigate to the login page and click the 'Forgot Password' link just below the password field.
Okay, I see the link and I clicked it. It’s asking for my registered email address.
Perfect. Please enter your company email address associated with your account, then press 'Submit'.
I’ve entered my email and submitted. Now it says a code has been sent to my phone.
Great! Once you receive the code on your phone, enter it in the verification box to proceed.
Done. Now it's asking me to create a new password.
Please choose a strong new password and confirm it. Once you’ve saved your changes, you should be able to log in.
All set! I’m back in my account. Thank you for your help.
